description: This file defines the CRNetworkManager class and related classes for managing network requests, responses, and interception in Chromium-based browser automation. It handles session management, request interception, response processing, and event handling for network activities within the Chromium protocol context.

classes.name: CRNetworkManager
classes.description: Manages network sessions, request interception, and response handling for Chromium protocol sessions.

classes.name: InterceptableRequest
classes.description: Represents an interceptable network request with associated request data and session info.

classes.name: RouteImpl
classes.description: Implements network route delegate for request continuation, fulfillment, and aborting.

classes.name: ResponseExtraInfoTracker
classes.description: Tracks and associates extra response info with network responses, ensuring headers are complete before finalization.

methods.name: addSession
methods.description: Adds a new network session, sets up event listeners, and enables network features.

methods.name: removeSession
methods.description: Removes a network session and cleans up event listeners.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Sets credentials for authentication and updates request interception accordingly.

methods.name: setOffline
methods.description: Enables or disables offline mode for all sessions.

methods.name: setExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Sets additional HTTP headers for all sessions.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears browser cache and disables cache temporarily.
